assertions.description: RTCPeerConnection.startDiagnosticLogging is a static function — the rewritten surface moved the API off navigator.rtc onto the RTCPeerConnection interface.
RTCPeerConnection.stopDiagnosticLogging is a static function — the rewrite renamed the finalising method from finishDiagnosticLogging to stopDiagnosticLogging.
RTCPeerConnection.cancelDiagnosticLogging is a static function — the rewrite keeps cancelDiagnosticLogging as the discard method.
The pre-rewrite Navigator binding is gone: navigator.rtc must not exist on the current surface (the API lives only as RTCPeerConnection statics).
startDiagnosticLogging() returns a non-empty session-ID string synchronously (a DOMString, never a Promise), and a session started this way is closed with stopDiagnosticLogging().
assertions.test: (()=>{const S=RTCPeerConnection.startDiagnosticLogging,T=RTCPeerConnection.stopDiagnosticLogging;if(typeof S!=='function'||typeof T!=='function')return false;let started=false;try{const r=S({metadata:{suite:'conformance'}});started=true;if(typeof r!=='string'||r.length===0)return false;if(typeof r.then==='function')return false;return true;}finally{if(started){try{T();}catch(_){}}}})()

assertions.description: Calling startDiagnosticLogging() while a session is already active throws InvalidStateError (the spec's first of three InvalidStateError contracts).
Calling stopDiagnosticLogging() with no active session throws InvalidStateError (the spec's second InvalidStateError contract).
Calling cancelDiagnosticLogging() with no active session throws InvalidStateError (the spec's third InvalidStateError contract).

startDiagnosticLogging() with more than 5 metadata entries, or with any key/value longer than 100 characters, throws a TypeError before any session starts (the rewrite made this a synchronous throw, and dropped allowUpload).
